bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-mp4-document-4d24)" || exit 61
docker exec -i deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs >/dev/null <<'SQL'
BEGIN;
DO $$
DECLARE affected int;
BEGIN
 UPDATE public_post_drafts d
 SET data=jsonb_set(d.data,'{media,type}','"document"'::jsonb,false)
 WHERE d.module='link' AND d.step='preview'
   AND d.data::text LIKE '%動画付きのリンク%'
   AND d.data->'media'->>'type'='video'
   AND NOT (d.data ? 'shareCode')
   AND d.owner_user_id IN (
     SELECT p.owner_user_id FROM link_button_posts p
     WHERE p.content='個別編集済みの安全テスト'
   );
 GET DIAGNOSTICS affected=ROW_COUNT;
 IF affected<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'LINK_VIDEO_FIXTURE_ROW_COUNT_INVALID';END IF;
END $$;
COMMIT;
SQL
count="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM public_post_drafts d WHERE d.module='link' AND d.step='preview' AND d.data::text LIKE '%動画付きのリンク%' AND d.data->'media'->>'type'='document' AND NOT (d.data ? 'shareCode') AND d.owner_user_id IN (SELECT p.owner_user_id FROM link_button_posts p WHERE p.content='個別編集済みの安全テスト');")" || exit 63
test "$count" = 1 || exit 64
echo LINK_OWNED_VIDEO_TEST_FIXTURE_DOCUMENT=PASS
echo USERBOT_SESSION=UNCHANGED
